_comment: skills-lock.json — pinned skill sources for bob-cloud-iac.
A skill is a SKILL.md file that Bob loads via use_skill. It can come from any source.
This file records where each installed skill came from and what version/commit was
vendored, so the workspace is reproducible and auditable.

terraform-multi-cloud-patterns.description: Reference module architectures for AWS, Azure, and GCP in Terraform, covering storage, messaging, serverless compute, remote state backends, provider configurations, and tagging standards.

iac-security-and-compliance.description: Security hardening controls, CIS cloud benchmark alignments, tfsec/checkov compliance checklists, private networking patterns, and least-privilege IAM policies in Terraform.

enterprise-data-iac-patterns.description: Terraform configurations for enterprise data integrations including Snowflake storage integrations, Databricks external locations, BigQuery datasets, Kafka, and data lake storage roles.

iac-quality-and-review.description: IaC quality checklist, security hardening audit items, CIS benchmark compliance, provider pinning rules, and P0/P1 review finding criteria for Terraform configurations.
